mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the previous quarter indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ growth is less than -1% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous two months signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO 2-month growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, the S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be positive over the next 20 trading days due to a favorable monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth is below 2%, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST 3-month growth exceeds 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp, but S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the previous month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.
